register: # TRANSPORT: enphase_rest (classes/transports/enphase_rest.py). Local HTTPS REST API of the IQ Gateway / Envoy, polled with a JWT bearer token (firmware 7.x+). Not Modbus; for the SunSpec Modbus TCP map see enphase_iq_gateway_sunspec.

# KEYS: register_key_type is text. The register column is <endpoint>#<json path>[|<aggregate>]. The path is dotted: object keys, list indexes, and * to walk every list element. A path containing * needs an aggregate: sum, avg, min, max or count. One request is made per endpoint per cycle, however many rows read from it.
# UNITS: the gateway reports power in milliwatts (agg_p_mw), so those rows use the unit 0.001W to deliver watts. Use a float type for values that carry fractions; whole-number types round.

# FIELD NAMES: the /api/v1/production fields, the agg_p_mw and soc keys of /ivp/livedata/status and connection.sc_stream are the names other integrations read on firmware 7.x. The nested meters.<name>.agg.p.avg shape once shown in documentation/devices/Enphase.md is not what they read. The remaining rows (mqtt_state, /ivp/ensemble/power, /api/v1/production/inverters) follow documentation/devices/Enphase.md and are unverified against a gateway; that endpoint's list key is written there as 'devices:' with a trailing colon, and the rows must match whatever the gateway sends.

# LIVE DATA: /ivp/livedata/status only carries fresh values while the gateway's live-data stream is enabled (connection.sc_stream is enabled). This transport does not enable it; the sc_stream row below shows the state. Per-inverter data refreshes every 5-15 minutes, hence the 300s read interval.
# SIGNS: sign conventions (grid import/export, battery charge/discharge) are as the gateway reports them; confirm against the Enphase app before building dashboards on them.
